business_summary: Broadmedia Corporation engages in information technology and education business in Japan. It operates through Studio Production, Technology, Education, and Others segments. The Studio Production segment engages in the production of Japanese subtitles and dubbing for foreign films and television programs, animations, and other visual content, as well as multilingual translation, Subtitles for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing (SDH), Audio Description (AD) for the blind and visually impaired, and other audio-visual productions; and operates Crank In!, an entertainment information site; Crank In! Trend; Crank In! Video that provides video content; and Crank In! Comic, a digital comic service. The Technology segment offers technology services, including the delivery of content through CDN; security services; providing digital transformation support; system development; AI-based solutions; CM online services that transmits large volumes of data; electronic delivery services for digital cinema; and cloud gaming platforms and apps. This segment also engages in the installation, maintenance and improvement of Wi-Fi environments for hotels; and video information systems for hotel guest rooms; provides digital cinema. The Education segment operates online e-learning high schools with various courses for students comprising of esports, a standard on-campus program, K-pop and beauty courses, as well as specialized courses in entertainment, study abroad, accounting, and sports; provides Japanese language education program for non-Japanese people; and provides AI and programming education. The Others segment manages the CAG OSAKA, a professional eSports team and promotes eSports business, as well as planning and management of esports-related events; and designs, develops, sells, and distributes games and VR software for the Nintendo Switch, PlayStationsVR, Meta Quest, and other platforms. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
